title: Writing tool schemas that survive a scrubber
focus: Give practitioners a concrete rule of thumb from prompt-scrub v1.5.0: the proxy scrubs free text everywhere but deliberately leaves tool names, tool-call ids, JSON-schema property keys and enum values alone because the model must echo them verbatim for the caller's dispatch to work, and show how the credential-key rule decides what to redact inside tool arguments, treating access_tokens as a secret while leaving max_tokens and generic names like key or auth alone.
